title: Democratic Impact Monitor: Open Public Contracting Tender Integrity and Asset Recovery Bill
objective: Ensure 100% public procurement OCDS portal compliance and asset recovery for substandard works.

indicators.name: Public Procurement OCDS Portal Disclosure Rate
indicators.definition: Percentage of public tenders published in full compliance with the Open Contracting Data Standard.

oversight.composition: Supreme Court judges, CAG representatives, engineering experts
oversight.powers: Statutory audit and contract cancellation directive

complaints.channel: Tender Integrity & Substandard Works Reporting Portal

triggers.condition: Collapse or structural degradation of public infrastructure during 10-year defect liability period.
triggers.detector: Public Infrastructure Failure Portal & Citizen Reports
triggers.interim_protection: Mandatory freezing of contractor assets and bank accounts
triggers.correction: Forensic engineering audit, syndicate prosecution, asset forfeiture
